cases.title: Retention keeps the newest applied runs
steps: Build and make a temp repo as TESTING.md describes
Commit graph-execution.config.json with {"keepRuns": 5}
Run the diamond fixture with --provider fake 7 times, committing the applied changes after each run
cases.expected: After the 7th run, exactly 6 run folders are left (the 5 newest applied runs kept by retention at the 7th run start, plus the 7th run), git branch --list "graph/*" lists exactly those 6 runs, and git branch --list "graph-task/*" is empty

cases.title: list shows runs and orphan branches
steps: In the temp repo after P1, create an orphan branch: git branch graph/old && git branch graph-task/old/1
Run node $CLI list
cases.expected: A table with each run id, status applied, age, size and branch, and a line 'Orphan branches: 2 (graph/* 1, graph-task/* 1)'; exit code 0

cases.title: clean removes unfinished runs and orphans, keeps live runs
steps: Start a run whose task 3 hangs (fake script {"task:3":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}}) in tmux and leave it running
Start a second run whose task 1 fails 3 times so it ends aborted (unfinished)
Create orphan branches graph/old and graph-task/old/1
Run node $CLI clean, answer n; then run node $CLI clean --yes
cases.expected: The first clean prints the plan (the aborted run, the orphans, the running run listed as skipped 'running (pid N)') and deletes nothing after 'n'. clean --yes deletes the aborted run's folder, worktrees and branches and the orphan branches; the hanging run's folder, worktrees and branches and the main branch are untouched

cases.title: Unfinished-runs hint at run start
steps: With an aborted run left from P3 (or a new one), start another diamond run with --provider fake
cases.expected: The run prints a line like '1 unfinished run uses 4.2 MB, run graph-execution clean' before it starts, and the unfinished run is not deleted

cases.title: Suite runs two features in parallel without applying early
steps: Copy src/__fixtures__/diamond to tasks/auth and tasks/export in the temp repo and commit
Run node $CLI suite --feature tasks/auth:$FIX/spec.md --feature tasks/export:$FIX/spec.md --provider fake --concurrency 4 --no-merge
cases.expected: Both features start (log lines 'feature auth started (run …, concurrency 2)' and for export), both end done, .graph-execution/suite-*/features/ holds two run folders, and the working tree has no applied changes; exit 0

cases.title: Conflicting features are integrated, checked and applied once
steps: Make two features whose tasks both write shared.txt with different content (fake script write fields), plus a fake script entry resolver:integration-<second feature> writing the resolved content
Run node $CLI suite --feature a:PRD-a.md --feature b:PRD-b.md --provider fake
cases.expected: Integration merges both into suite/<id>, the integration agent resolves shared.txt (its prompt contains both PRDs), the e2e phase runs (reviewer and tester reports in suite-*/reports/round0), and the combined changes appear once as uncommitted changes in the working tree; suite.json status is applied

cases.title: Features beyond the cap are queued
steps: Make 3 features from the diamond fixture
Run node $CLI suite with the 3 features and --concurrency 2 --provider fake --no-merge
cases.expected: Two features start with concurrency 1, the third starts only after one of them ends (log order), and all three end done

cases.title: Retry a failed feature from the suite page
steps: Start a suite with --web (GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached SSH_CONNECTION=1) where feature b's task 1 fails 3 times
Open the printed URL with agent-browser; wait until b's lane shows failed and a Retry button
Fix the fake script so task 1 succeeds, click Retry on b
cases.expected: b's lane goes back to running, then done; the integration lane shows both merges, then the e2e phase, then applied; Close ends the process

cases.title: No overlapping files skips the cross-feature reviewer
steps: Run a suite of two features that write different files, --provider fake
cases.expected: suite-*/reports/round0/code.json notes contain 'code review not needed', no reviewer agent ran, and the result is applied

cases.title: Start integration without a feature that keeps failing
steps: Start a suite with --web where feature b always fails and a succeeds
On the page, wait until a is done and b failed; click Start integration
cases.expected: b's lane shows excluded, only a is merged into suite/<id>, the suite ends applied and the summary lists b as excluded
